Test image sequences for flashing

Want to know if toggling quickly between a series of pictures creates dangerous flashing lights? Load your pictures here to measure each image's overall brightness and test every combination safely in memory.

How this works (Safe & Automated)

1 Add your images

Upload files or paste image URLs, then click "Load images without playback".

2 Screen safely in memory

Click "Screen all ordered pairs". The tool tests brightness jumps without flashing your screen.

3 Review flash results

See each image's brightness (Y), contrast difference (ΔY), and whether toggling triggers flash alarms.

1. Select or load your images

Local files stay 100% in this browser. You can load up to 32 static pictures. Animated GIF/APNG files are rejected.

2. Choose toggle speed & display size

Note: Two image changes equal one complete flash cycle (Image A → Image B → Image A). WCAG restricts content from flashing more than 3 times per second.
